The rule was written by the session in round 21, and the user lifted the R9 'public knob ladders' clause for public-aimed slots (26 Sep 21:31Z). The session may therefore amend (4) itself, as long as it does so before the scores (ledger header 07:02:42Z shows 47-50 PENDING; 50 is expected ~12:30Z). Three defects in the finding: (a) Discussion 743929 disclosed only READMIT 0.94 and ILP 0.4, plus the two-arm process. The values 0.92 and 0.98 are our own extrapolations, so calling them 'disclosed-knob arms' overstates the aggressive-mode cover. (b) The JT(b) stacks (exp86a/86b/87d) do not need the exception, because they are FULL stacks under (1)-1 once 50 reads '+'. ILP 0.4 as a single rung (exp85b, +49 nodes) is near-inert and already closed as a slot (R24S-11), so it should be allowed only inside the JT pair. (c) Carving out (4) does not open the after-02:00Z window: (5) is a whitelist that needs the user's yes, and the finding should say so rather than imply otherwise. Value caveat: READMIT arms move nodes by +-1%. The lab found 0 of 6,696 candidates in the [0.94, 0.965) band near GT. Public is one embryo shown to 3 decimals, so a +/-0.001 read is weak evidence for private. The line enables cheap reads, not a proven gain. Feasibility is fine: knob-only cell-0 builds, byte-identical parent otherwise (diff-checked), runtime ~0, and GPU for dummies (~25 min each) is within ~7 h.
